scope: Checked-out static setup landing candidate; not a released setup binary
command: env -u KB_ROOT mise exec -- make site-check

checks: Real clipboard contents match every complete visible command/prompt block
Denied clipboard feedback never reports false success
Audience tabs support pointer and keyboard navigation with visible focus
Both setup views have no horizontal page overflow
Both setup views have no serious or critical axe findings
Built page emits no browser, console, HTTP or external runtime resource errors
Animation pause/replay/advance, reduced motion and no-JavaScript transcript remain usable
Full-page human and agent screenshots generated at both viewports
observations.manual_browser_review: Desktop and mobile human/agent setup views inspected; mobile horizontal overflow observed as zero

limits: Local artifacts are ignored build output, not public screenshot links until deliberately included in the review.
Published v1.0.0 does not include setup; these website checks do not qualify a new runtime release.
No native setup, agent activation or hook delivery claim follows from illustrative sessions or screenshots.
Serious/critical axe checks and finite Chromium scenarios do not establish complete accessibility or universal browser support.
Remote documentation availability is not a gate; same-document fragments are checked.
